best_verifier_from.principle: which arm (D1/D2/D3) provided the best verifier by MuSR delta_vs_tuned_sc.

delta_vs_tuned_sc_second.principle: the cross-corpus moat lift (signed); CI95-excl-0 is the generalization confirmation.

headroom_present.principle: true required on the 2nd corpus for an informative result (FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISK guard); if false, the corpus is excluded from the moat claim.

honest_verdict.principle: terminal prefix; a win is success_moat_generalizes_<corpus>_<delta>, a scoped result is complete_moat_musr_scoped_<corpus>_no_confirm.

inference_substrate.principle: live_llm_inference (live generation; >=60s) or verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates if candidates are reused.

model_specs.principle: the generator + the best verifier -- the methodology stamp.

paired_ci95_second.principle: paired bootstrap CI95 of the 2nd-corpus delta.

preconditions_checked.principle: records verifier/corpus/headroom checks; a missing resource emits blocked_.

second_corpus.principle: the chosen confirmed-cached headroom-present oracle-distinct corpus (GPQA/MMLU-Pro-hard/MATH-500-hard).

second_corpus_accuracy.principle: the best verifier's oracle-distinct accuracy on the 2nd corpus.

tuned_sc_accuracy_second.principle: the TUNED-SC baseline on the 2nd corpus (headroom-control).

verifier_is_oracle.principle: false -- the best verifier scores reasoning quality, never the answer's executable correctness (must pass check_circular_moat_overclaim).

best_verifier_model_specs.base_scorer_detail: checked-in distributional energy quality ensemble fallback
best_verifier_model_specs.conflict_filter: drop same-answer pseudo-pairs; require positive reward margin
best_verifier_model_specs.hybrid_initialization: base reward mean plus pool-disagreement spread

preconditions_checked.detail: D1 artifact is blocked/skeleton or lacks numeric verifier metrics
D2 artifact is blocked/skeleton or lacks numeric verifier metrics
